body:
Follow-up from #460. **Dependency #460 was satisfied by PR #903**, merged at `3706c9a95b3ec06348b87f24ea4b2fd64db242a9`. This remains source research/restoration and engineering recommendations only.; all work is source research/restoration and engineering recommendations only. This does not approve Cabinda, alter location records, modify boundaries, authorize imports, or approve publication.

## Finding from #460
Angola's Official Gazette Law 14/24 (5 September 2024), Article 5, lists ten Cabinda municipalities: Cabinda, Cacongo, Buco Zau, Belize, Miconje, Massabi, Necuto, Tando Zinze, Liambo, and Ngoio. The four legacy Cabinda ADM2 members below come from a 2018 geoBoundaries humanitarian source and cannot establish current complete coverage. The law's municipality articles define boundary descriptions and its annex maps; the PDF has no cleared open reuse license in this review. See #460's packet for citations and the exact PDF/source hashes.

## Bounded work
Locate authoritative, current, publicly reusable municipal boundary geometry for the ten statutory Cabinda municipalities, or obtain authoritative reuse permission and georeference/restoration directions for the official annex maps. Crosswalk the four exact existing IDs individually, identify whether their identities/footprints persist under the new division, and document six statutory municipalities not yet represented in these IDs. Record territorial meaning, parent, source vintage, completeness, license, neighboring granularity, exact source hashes/retrieval date and reproducible results. Propose required engineering work while preserving old IDs/history and coordinating predecessor/parent updates. Do not edit production geography.

Exact existing scoped location IDs:
- `gb:AGO:ADM2:16411231B22766430211667`
- `gb:AGO:ADM2:16411231B42954517222252`
- `gb:AGO:ADM2:16411231B63355352791940`
